source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: DP-CATE preserves Neyman orthogonality and quasi-oracle efficiency under nuisance-privatization regularity, and gives DP functional CATE releases; it contains no confidence-interval theorem.
PrivATE targets the population ATE, combines a private ATE estimate with a private variance estimate, and constructs a valid private CI accounting for estimation and privatization uncertainty.
PrivSub is a black-box private-estimator subsampling construction whose interval validity and tightness are asymptotic and conditional on a consistency requirement for the private estimator.
The article studies honest bias-aware intervals for pointwise nonparametric regression under Taylor/Hölder restrictions, without causal higher-order nuisance correction or differential privacy.
